obligations.boundary: Branch or worktree vs origin main, scratch age
obligations.owed: A scheduled run on the machine or codespace where worktrees live: a runner clone has no stale branches, so the daily workflow cannot judge them.
obligations.source: scratch/worktrees.json (kit.worktrees.v1) and the mtime of every entry of scratch/
obligations.verifier: kit check staleness --local on the machine

obligations.owed: Authenticated ingress for the comms engine so a GitHub runner can send the owner's email: POST /v1/comms/dispatch with a signed bearer, an OpenAPI contract and tests; today the engine is reachable only over a service binding.
obligations.source: packages/comms (the engine's dispatch route) and the OPS_NOTIFY_TO secret of the engine
obligations.verifier: a contract test of the route and kit comms secrets

obligations.owed: Run kit check staleness inside each codespace, and generate the codespace definition (codespaces.json) from registry/toolchain.json instead of keeping a second copy.
obligations.source: registry/toolchain.json against node, npm, git and docker --version inside the codespace

obligations.boundary: GitHub environments, secrets and tokens vs registry
obligations.owed: Compare the secret and environment names the GitHub API lists with the registry that declares them; today only the age of the registry's verified day is checked.
